author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first homestead ledger. Track crops, harvests, preserves and produce inventory, supplies, task boards, and your yearly garden journal — all in one place. Data lives on your NAS.

tips.before_install:
## Homestead Ledger

Data (crops, harvests, inventory, tasks, journal) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/homestead-ledger/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Homestead Ledger
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted homestead ledger with on-NAS storage.
